linear.notes: Parameters of the staged fit (stage 1 prefit -> stage 2 inverse calibration, epoch 700 of 1000 -> stage 3 regeneration with a fitted Beverton-Holt cap) on two-interval-v8/train. Fitted with FINN 0.2.0 release candidate 6705a50 (fast-setup + F1); extracted as a named parameter list and validated with FINN 0.2.0 main 0848b60, under which fit(weight_scale = 'raw') reproduces the fit objective. url is filled by the release; until then load_model(path = <local parameters.pt>).
